summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Rizz AI SaaS platform including all admin features, AI functionality, and image upload capabilities. Backend APIs achieved 100% pass rate across 24 test cases. Frontend testing confirmed proper loading, navigation, and admin authentication flow working correctly.

integration_issues.flow: Protected route access via direct URL
integration_issues.issue: Direct navigation to protected routes (/bio-generator, /profile-review) redirects to landing page even with valid session token
integration_issues.details: Authentication works correctly through normal flow (login -> dashboard -> features) but direct URL access to protected pages fails. May need to implement proper route protection handling for deep links.

passed_tests: Backend API Health Check (24/24 endpoints including admin features)
AI Generation Endpoints (conversation-starters, chat-reply, bio-generator, profile-review)
Admin Settings Management (site, pricing, prompts, API keys)
Unauthorized Access Protection (401/403 responses for protected endpoints)
Admin Login Flow with Password Authentication
Back to App Navigation from Admin Panel
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor integration issue: Protected route access via direct URLs needs enhancement. The OAuth-based authentication flow works correctly through normal user journey, but direct deep linking to protected pages redirects to landing page. Consider implementing better handling for authenticated deep links or session validation on protected routes.
